node.question: Is a frog visibly present in the edited image?
node.criteria: pass: a frog is visibly present. fail: the image clearly shows no frog. unknown: the image does not establish whether a frog is present.
node.binding: Visual presence of the requested frog; presence alone does not establish placement inside the toilet.
